ns2:course.label: Empirical Ind Organization
ns2:course.description: Empirical Methods in Industrial Organization. Topics include: detection of anticompetitive behavior; estimation techniques that allow for product differentiation, endogenous entry and intertemporal decision-making; estimation and testing of auctions and other asymmetric information models.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to PHD:Economics -UIUC.
